doctrine: Jarvis is the founder/operator surface, not the backend authority.
Backend command bus and PostgreSQL truth vault remain authority.
Every action must pass policy and evidence requirements.
No external tool may silently mutate Kingsmen truth.

milestones.name: Jarvis Kernel Chain
milestones.purpose: Centralise Jarvis runtime into one governed kernel path.
acceptance: Kernel returns typed result for safe command.
Unknown command returns BLOCKED.
Every result includes evidence reference and policy outcome.

milestones.name: Intent Router and Command Registry
milestones.purpose: Replace loose phrase matching with typed intents and registered commands.
acceptance: HUD command cards can be generated from registry.
Low-confidence command does not execute sensitive action.
Unknown commands are blocked.

milestones.name: Executable Policy Gate
milestones.purpose: Turn Jarvis laws into runtime decisions.
acceptance: Safe read command passes.
Sensitive write command returns APPROVAL_REQUIRED.
Blocked command includes a human-readable reason.

milestones.name: Evidence Ledger Upgrade
milestones.purpose: Move from only local JSONL evidence toward queryable evidence events.
acceptance: Every command creates evidence.
Evidence has command id, risk, result, output hash, and timestamp.
Sensitive values are redacted.

milestones.name: Approval Centre
milestones.purpose: Allow Jarvis to prepare sensitive actions without executing them silently.
acceptance: Approval request appears in HUD.
Reject prevents execution.
Approve executes only the prepared command and records evidence.

milestones.name: Adapter Registry
milestones.purpose: Convert direct command execution into governed adapters.
acceptance: Kernel calls adapters by registered id.
Adapter timeout and failure are handled cleanly.
Adapter output appears in evidence drawer.

milestones.name: Final HUD Components
milestones.purpose: Turn current Jarvis HUD into maintainable final command cockpit components.
acceptance: Founder can use Jarvis without developer console.
Every claim shows evidence or confidence.
Risky action shows approval card.

milestones.name: Real Voice Stack
milestones.purpose: Add wake word, local speech-to-text, and speech output with browser fallback.
acceptance: Voice transcript appears in HUD.
Safe voice command runs.
Sensitive voice command asks for approval.

milestones.name: Document Smart Intake
milestones.purpose: Use documents to prefill candidate smart forms.
acceptance: CV upload creates draft work history fields.
Identity/legal fields require review.
No extracted field becomes truth until approved.

milestones.name: Portal Scout
milestones.purpose: Inspect route/source health and generate evidence for MAP/manual fallback.
acceptance: Scout can inspect a public route page.
Scout result updates route health read model.
Uncertain route goes to manual review.

milestones.name: Kingsmen Operational Adapters
milestones.purpose: Make Jarvis useful across candidate, application, document, finance, comms, and fallback operations.
acceptance: Jarvis can explain what blocks a candidate.
Jarvis can draft email-first messages for approval.
Jarvis can prepare a manual package draft.

milestones.name: Brain Provider and Deployment Modes
milestones.purpose: Add AI reasoning behind policy and make Jarvis runnable in local, server, and hybrid modes.
acceptance: Model can explain results but cannot execute unregistered commands.
Local mode starts with one command.
Server mode has no Windows-only hard dependency.
Hybrid mode can run safe remote commands.

final_definition_of_done: Founder can launch Jarvis with one command.
Founder can talk or type to Jarvis.
Jarvis asks approval for sensitive actions.
Jarvis executes approved tools through adapters.
Jarvis records evidence for every action.
Jarvis can read Kingsmen status across candidate, document, route, finance, comms, and system surfaces.
Jarvis can draft but not silently send sensitive communication.
Jarvis can run in local and server modes.
